purpose.domain_detail: COBOL training exercise (Treinamento Cobol) for client registration system, written in 2012 by Jackson R Wippel at HBSIS Informática
purpose.summary: A menu-driven client (customer) cadastre (registration) program that supports adding, updating, deleting, and printing client records from an indexed file. It includes a simple report generator that writes to a file and calls an external print module. Written as a COBOL training exercise using Git.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with blank screen and line/column display
ACCEPT from ESCAPE KEY for function key handling
88-level condition names for function keys and PgUp/PgDn
Indexed file I/O with START/READ NEXT loop
STRING verb for building report filename from time
CALL to external relatorio-impressao module with CANCEL
COPY for screen layouts and file descriptors (4 copybooks)
verdict.notes: Program is a 2012 COBOL training exercise. Author and date-written are in the IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. Some duplicate section labels (e.g. 2005-cadastro-cidades and 2004-cadastro-cidades have empty bodies). The 2002-excluir section is missing its section header label. COMP-X and SCREEN SECTION strongly suggest GnuCOBOL or Micro Focus; the overall style and box-drawing characters lean toward GnuCOBOL. One line exceeds 72 columns (column 91 max).
